_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. Not generated, and deliberately so - the archive can measure how long a fight
takes but has no way to see what has to be done FIRST, and this pack is modded so the answers
are not vanilla Elden Ring's.
AND is the plain list. Everything in it is needed:
"Radabeast": ["Hoarah Loux", "restore a great rune"]
OR is a nested list. Any ONE of the things inside it is enough:
"Golden Godfrey": [["DTS", "Fortissax"]]
The two combine, so this needs Messmer AND either Romina or Metyr:
"Example": ["Messmer", ["Romina", "Metyr, Mother of Fingers"]]
_locations does the same job keyed by PLACE instead of by boss, so a rule that covers a dozen
squares is written once. The key is matched against the location half of a square's tooltip - the
part after the dash - so "Jagged Peak" catches every square there.
A square gets its own entry AND any location rule that matches it; they add together.
- A prerequisite that matches ANOTHER SQUARE on the same board is shared work. The team was
going there anyway, so it costs nothing extra.
- A prerequisite that matches nothing on the board is pure overhead - work with no square to
show for it - and is charged in full to whichever fleet sits on that square.
That second case is what this file exists for. 'Ymir is gated behind Metyr, who isn't on the
board' is invisible to every other measure and decides matches.
Names must match src/data/battleshipChallenges.json exactly. Run:
node scripts/check-prereqs.mjs
which lists anything it cannot resolve and shows what the rules currently cover.
"long run" is a placeholder for 'nothing gates this, it is just far'. It is not a boss and will
never match a square; it is here so those squares can be told apart from ones with no entry at
all. What it should COST is still open - see the questions at the bottom.
Partial is fine. Leave out anything you are unsure of - a wrong entry silently reprices a fleet,
a missing one just leaves that square behaving as it does today.
1. Whether a non-boss prerequisite ('restore a great rune', 'long run') carries its own rough
cost in minutes, or just counts as a flat overhead.
2. Whether two squares needing the SAME off-board prerequisite are charged once between them or
once each.
